No tile extends past the wooden frame on any side ✓. issues: VISUAL OBSERVATION (not blocking — per spec the side chips are INTENTIONALLY positioned to overlap the frame edges): once the chain reaches the middle row of the frame at y≈364, the left chip (damma-player-card-left, x:10–87) and right chip (damma-player-card-right, x:303–380) sit on top of the played dominoes. In the captured screenshot the leftmost and rightmost chain tiles are partially obscured by the P2 and P4 pills. Per the GAME FOCUS MODE brief the chips MUST float over the wooden frame, so this is by design — but main agent may want to add a tiny semi-transparent backdrop or shift the chips slightly outward if user feedback flags reduced tile visibility.

critical_code_review_comments: damma.tsx: GAME FOCUS MODE layout is clean. boardArea uses flex:1 + marginTop:28 reserve for the floating top chip; chipTop is absolute at top:-28 so it sits in the reserved gap without pushing the frame. chipLeft/chipRight use top:'50%' + marginTop:-16 which centers a 32-px-tall pill correctly. chipTimer at top:-26/right:6 and chipBoneyard at right:4/bottom:4 sit OVER the wood without consuming layout — verified empirically (frame.getBoundingClientRect identical before/after rendering).

PlayerChip.tsx is a focused, well-encapsulated component (~157 lines). State-only popup (no portal) renders absolute over the chip; popupDirection prop drives the correct popupStyles preset (top/bottom/left/right). minHeight:28 + paddingHorizontal:6 keeps the pill ≤100 px wide even with 'Bot — Top' subLabel hidden in the chip (subLabel only shows inside the popup). Avatar fallback to robot icon is good defensive UX.

Per the agent_to_agent context: pre-existing i18n drift (English 'Your Turn', 'Place the first tile', 'SCORE', 'BONEYARD') is INTENTIONALLY out-of-scope for iter-11 and was NOT flagged as a defect. Pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings are RN-web noise and per the brief NOT flagged.

Legacy styles (tableRow/sideColumn/scoreBar/oppHand/tileBack/topPlayerRow/sidePlayersRow/timerBox/timerWarn/timerText/etc.) are correctly set to display:'none' to avoid TS-errors on legacy refs. ~17 dead style entries could be deleted in a follow-up cleanup pass once a grep confirms no consumer still references them — purely a code-hygiene nit.

MINOR (not blocking): in 4P the side chips have w≈77 px and sit at x=10 and x=303 — i.e. the LEFT EDGE of the left chip is OUTSIDE the wooden frame (frame.left=12). It is essentially flush. Same on the right (chip.right=380 vs frame.right=378). This is acceptable per the spec ('they overlap the wooden frame's edges') but if visual polish is desired the chip could be tucked 2-4 px inward.
